title: EngagementCreated
description: Emitted by the Engagement Management Service when a new engagement file is created. Consumed to populate the Template Subscribers Index (template_id -> firm_id/engagement_id/region), establishing which engagements must be considered on future template fan-outs.

engagement_id.description: Identifier of the newly created engagement file.

firm_id.description: Identifier of the firm the engagement belongs to. Used as the partition key for all firm-scoped stores.

region.description: Data-residency region the firm's engagement data (and this feature's indexes) must stay within, e.g. 'us', 'eu', 'ca'.

template_id.description: Identifier of the product template used to create the engagement.

template_version.description: Version of the product template the engagement was created from (becomes the engagement's base_version).
